parts.headline: A cap statement is a one-page sales sheet, not a brochure.
paragraphs: Contracting officers see dozens of these a week. If your contact info isn't visible on page one, they move on. This kit walks you through the CapturePilot Canva template — brand kit setup, the section-by-section swap list, and the export settings that actually print.
Open canva.com/templates and search 'federal capability statement', or use the kit link you got with this download. A free Canva account is enough.

parts.html:
STEP 1 · SET UP YOUR BRAND KIT IN CANVA

Five minutes of setup saves an hour per design.

Canva's Brand Kit lives in the left sidebar. Once it's set, every new design pulls your logo, colors, and fonts automatically. Do this before you open the template.

  1. Open Canva (free or Pro) and click Brand Kit in the left sidebar.
  2. Upload your logo in PNG or SVG. Transparent background preferred. SVG scales without pixelating.
  3. Add your brand colors by entering hex codes (for example, #1D4ED8 for navy). Primary, accent, neutral — three is enough.
  4. Set your brand fonts. One for headers, one for body. If you don't have brand fonts yet, pick a clean sans like Inter or Source Sans.
  5. Save the kit. It applies automatically to every new Canva design from this point forward.
FIELD TIP
Don't have a logo yet? Use a clean text wordmark in your primary brand font, set in your primary color. A clear text logo beats a messy graphic every time.

Why this matters before you touch the template

The CapturePilot template is wired to your Brand Kit. Logo placeholders pull your uploaded logo. Header bars and accents pull your primary color. Skip this step and you'll be hand-swapping every element on every page.

STEP 2 · CUSTOMIZE THE TEMPLATE

Section by section, what to replace and how.

Open the template and work top to bottom. Don't skip — every section matters to a contracting officer scanning your sheet.

SectionWhat to replaceDesign tip
Header / Logo Area Replace placeholder logo with yours. Update company name. Logo should be at least 300 DPI. Use SVG when you have it.
Company Overview Box Delete placeholder text. Paste your 2-4 sentence overview. Keep it under 75 words. Bold one key number (years in business, contracts delivered, revenue).
Core Competencies Replace each item with your own. Four to six entries. Start each line with a strong verb. Keep formatting consistent across all six.
Differentiators Column Write three specific differentiators. Use the formula from the main cap statement guide. Put your strongest differentiator first. Generic claims get ignored — be specific.

STEP 2 · CUSTOMIZE THE TEMPLATE (CONTINUED)

Past performance, certifications, contact, accents.

SectionWhat to replaceDesign tip
Past Performance Table Fill in contract details from your records. Include the POC name. Agencies call the POCs you list. If you can't list one, leave the row out.
Certifications / Badges Delete the certs you don't hold. Keep only the ones you've verified. SDVOSB badge only if you're CVE-verified. False badges kill credibility on the spot.
Contact Block Name, title, phone, email, address, website. Use a monitored email — not a personal Gmail. A @company.com address signals you're a real shop.
Color Accents Apply your brand color to header bars and icons. One accent color reads more professional than three or four.
WHY THIS MATTERS

Every placeholder you forget to replace is a tell that you rushed. Contracting officers notice the same way you'd notice a typo in a resume. Slow down on the swap pass.

STEP 3 · EXPORT YOUR CAPABILITY STATEMENT

The export settings that don't get you rejected.

  1. Click Share → Download in Canva.
  2. Choose PDF Print for the highest quality output.
  3. Tick Crop marks and bleed if you're submitting to a print shop.
  4. For email attachments, choose PDF Standard instead — smaller file, cleaner inboxes.
  5. Name the file [CompanyName]_CapStatement_FY2026.pdf. Contracting officers grep for company names.
  6. Save a copy in both PDF and original Canva format so you can edit it next quarter without starting over.
PRO TIP · ONE-PAGE RULE

If your cap statement runs past page one, it's already failed. Contracting officers scan dozens a week. Page two means your company description is too long or your formatting is too loose. Cut the overview by half. Trim past-performance rows to the three most relevant. Move long bios to a separate one-pager.

STEP 4 · COLOR PALETTES FOR FEDERAL CONTRACTORS

Five sector-tested combos. Drop in the hex codes.

Pick the row that matches what you sell. Drop the hex codes straight into your Canva Brand Kit and you're done.

SectorPrimaryAccentNeutralWhy it works
Defense / IC Navy #1B2A4A Gold #C9A84C Gray #4B5563 Conservative. Trust signals for DoD and intel buyers.
IT / Cyber Dark #0F172A Green #22C55E Gray #6B7280 Tech-forward without looking like a consumer app.
Healthcare Blue #1E40AF Teal #0D9488 Warm Gray #78716C Clean and clinical. Reads trustworthy to VA and HHS buyers.
Construction Dark Green #14532D Orange #EA580C Stone #D6D3D1 Grounded, structural. Works for USACE, GSA, NAVFAC.
Pro Services Charcoal #1C1917 Emerald #059669 Sand #E7E5E4 Executive, consultancy feel. Pairs with serif body fonts.
